transcript:
**Agent:** Good afternoon! Thank you for calling TechSolutions, this is Lisa. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Lisa, I’m having some issues with my billing. I noticed an extra charge on my statement this month.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that, and I’d be happy to help you sort this out. Can you provide me with your account email address, please?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@example.com. I thought I was just on the Standard plan.

**Agent:** Thanks for that, John. Let me take a quick look at your account. *[pause]* It seems you were upgraded to the Pro plan last month due to a promotional offer. Did you mean to change plans?

**Customer:** No, I didn’t! I just wanted to stick with the Standard plan. I’m really unhappy because this wasn’t what I signed up for.

**Agent:** I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for any confusion. Would you like me to switch your account back to the Standard plan?

**Customer:** Yes, please! And can you also refund me the extra charge?

**Agent:** Absolutely, I’ll process the refund right away. It’ll take 3-5 business days to reflect in your account. 

**Customer:** Thank you! And can you confirm the features of the Standard plan for me?

**Agent:** Of course! The Standard plan includes basic features like 5GB storage, email support, and access to our knowledge base. You can always upgrade later if you wish. 

**Customer:** Got it. That sounds good. I appreciate your help, Lisa.

**Agent:** My pleasure, John! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

**Customer:** No, that’s everything. Thanks again for your help!

**Agent:** You’re very welcome! Have a great day, and don’t hesitate to reach out if you have more questions in the future!
